_why: Our own obstruction research names exact cabins in its prose and we only ever applied it as 'deck 6, all sections'. This lifts those numbers out. Read by hand, one zone at a time, because roughly a third of them name cabins that are CLEAR rather than blocked — a regex over these would have inverted them.
_polarity: blocked = a boat/structure is in front of this room. clear = named as the EXCEPTION, this room escapes the obstruction its neighbours have.
_rule: Numbers are expanded then intersected with the real grid. Nothing is written for a cabin that does not exist.
